entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6647"/><title type="x-s2">PSALM 101</title> <title type="x-s3"><reference osisRef="Ps.101.1-Ps.101.8">Psa 101:1-8</reference>. In this Psalm the profession of the principles of his domestic and political government testifies, as well as actions in accordance with it, David's appreciation of God's mercy to him, and His judgment on his enemies: and thus he sings or celebrates God's dealings.</title> <div sID="gen10179" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6647"/>2. He avows his sincere purpose, by God's aid, to act uprightly (<reference osisRef="Gen.17.1">Ge 17:1</reference>; <reference osisRef="Ps.18.30">Psa 18:30</reference>). <div eID="gen10179" type="x-p"/>

entries.content_plain: 3. set ... eyes-- as an example to be approved and followed. no wicked thing-- literally, "word," plan or purpose of Belial ( Psa 41:8 ). work of ... aside-- apostates. not cleave to me-- I will not be implicated in it (compare Psa 1:1-3 ).
